subject: Supplier onboarding: banking ops, remit email, and invoice delivery
messages:
From: Sarah Long <sarah.long@greencrest.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: David Miller <david.miller@greencrest.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding: banking ops, remit email, and invoice delivery

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the intro — happy to kick off GreenCrest's vendor onboarding for Redwood. To get our AP set up we need a few quick confirmations:

- Preferred payment rails: ACH domestic (USD) vs wire (we can support both).
- Remittance email for invoice confirmations and remittance advices (where we should send remittance notices).
- Invoice submission method: email PDF to AP, upload to our portal (Coupa), or send via SFTP.
- Any PO number format you require on invoices (prefix, length) and whether Redwood issues POs for all orders.

Attached: GreenCrest supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx and our W-9. I can fill the bank details once you confirm which rails you accept and whether Redwood prefers ACH routing or wires for initial payments.

Target timeline: we'd like to be able to submit the first invoice by Dec 8th. Let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks,
Sarah Long
Sr. AP Manager, GreenCrest Foods
attachments: supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx, W-9.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@greencrest.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: banking ops, remit email, and invoice delivery

Hi Sarah — great to meet you. I'm Connor on the procurement side — looping in Laura (Finance) and Ben (Ops) to confirm specifics. Short answers up-front:

- We support ACH (preferred for US payouts) and wire for exceptions. For ACH we'll need account number + routing + bank name; for wires we'll need SWIFT + beneficiary info.
- Remittance email: we can accept remittance at ap-remit@redwood.com or via an ERP-specific remit-to string if you have an automated system.
- Invoice submission: both emailed PDFs to ap@redwood.com and portal uploads work. If you use a portal (Coupa/Ariba) we can configure PO acceptance there.
- PO format: Redwood POs are typically 6-digit numeric (e.g., 100234) and we require the PO number on the invoice to auto-match.

Next steps I propose (mutual action plan):
1) Sarah: return your completed onboarding form + bank authorization (masking full acct numbers, last 4 ok) — you mentioned attaching bank file.
2) Redwood (Laura/Ben): verify tax docs & W-9, set up vendor record, and confirm PO/portal routing.
3) Sign vendor agreement (DocuSign link below) if not already complete.

I've attached our vendor setup worksheet for your convenience. If ACH works, we'll prioritize that on first payment.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_setup_form.xlsx

Connor O'Brien
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
ap-remit@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
attachments: redwood_vendor_setup_form.xlsx

From: Sarah Long <sarah.long@greencrest.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@greencrest.com
Date: 2026-11-29T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: banking ops, remit email, and invoice delivery

Connor — thanks, attached is the completed supplier_onboarding_form and a bank_authorization.pdf. Quick answers inline:

- Payment rails: ACH domestic (USD) preferred. We can send wires on request for same-day payments for amounts > $25k.
- Remit email: accounts-payable@greencrest.com (please add to your AP distribution).
- Invoice submission: we prefer portal uploads (Coupa). If Redwood will accept emailed PDFs until Coupa is configured, please confirm the email target.
- PO numbers: We'll include Redwood PO exactly as issued; we'll add the 6-digit PO to the invoice header.

Bank (masked): First Bank — acct ending 9921, ABA 021000021. I'll attach a signed bank authorization PDF.

Attachment: completed_supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx, bank_authorization.pdf

Let me know if you need a vendor contact for remittance inquiries — it's our AP team at accounts-payable@greencrest.com.

Cheers,
Sarah
attachments: completed_supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx, bank_authorization.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@greencrest.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: banking ops, remit email, and invoice delivery

Thanks Sarah — this is perfect. Laura — can you confirm finance has what they need to create the vendor and enable ACH to the masked account (ending 9921)? Also, can you confirm whether we should direct invoices to ap@redwood.com (temporary) or await Coupa mapping?

Action items and timeline:
- Laura: add GreenCrest as a vendor, validate W-9 and bank auth, enable ACH rails (by 2026-12-03).
- Ben/Proc Ops: configure PO matching rules for 6-digit POs and add accounts-payable@greencrest.com to remit mailing list.
- Sarah: once vendor is in our system, we'll send an acknowledgement and a DocuSign for the supplier agreement. Expect final sign-off + first payment scheduling by Dec 10, assuming invoices are received by Dec 8 as requested.

Sarah, I added the DocuSign link here for the agreement if you'd like to sign now: https://app.docusign.com/XYZ-GreenCrest-Vendor-Agreement

Thanks again — small ask: can you confirm whether GreenCrest requires an EFT test deposit prior to first ACH? If so, we'll coordinate token test deposit and confirm routing.

Connor O'Brien
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
ap-remit@redwood.com
attachments: none
